Summary: Shop Admin Onboarding & Operations
Description: As a shop/seller admin I want to onboard with valid business data get approved manage multiple stores products and orders and handle shipping refunds and returns so that I can sell and fulfill orders on the platform in a controlled auditable way. Covers: Onboarding (registration KYC approval) Stores (multi-store) Products (catalog CRUD bulk import inventory) Orders (unified list filters status) Fulfillment (shipping refunds returns) Supporting (payouts tax analytics notifications).

Summary: Shop admin can register with valid business and contact data
Description: As a shop/seller admin I want to register with my business name type address contact details and tax ID so that the platform can verify my business and consider me for approval. Acceptance: Registration accepts business name type address phone tax ID and user details (name email password). Email unique; password policy. On success status PENDING_APPROVAL; email verification. Clear validation errors. No seller dashboard access until APPROVED.

Summary: Shop admin can upload KYC documents during onboarding
Description: As a shop/seller admin I want to upload ID proof business registration and address proof so that the platform can verify my identity and business before approval. Acceptance: Upload ID proof business cert address proof. File type/size enforced. Stored securely linked to shop. Admin can list and re-upload if rejected. Platform can view and mark verified/rejected with reason.

Summary: Platform can approve or reject shop admin after review
Description: As platform/super-admin I want to review pending shop admins (business + KYC) and approve or reject so that only verified sellers can add stores and sell. Acceptance: List PENDING_APPROVAL with filters. View shop profile and documents. Approve or Reject with reason. On Approve status APPROVED; admin can access store management. On Reject status REJECTED; notify admin; reapply possible. Welcome email on approval.

Summary: Approved shop admin can add and manage multiple stores
Description: As approved shop admin I want to create multiple stores (name address contact logo business hours) so that I can sell from different locations or brands under one account. Acceptance: Only APPROVED can create. Create: name address phone logo business hours timezone currency. List edit deactivate. Unique store identifier. Default shipping origin.

Summary: Platform or shop defines categories for products
Description: As shop admin I want to assign my products to categories (platform or custom) so that products are organized and discoverable. Acceptance: Categories at platform or store level. Name optional parent tree optional image isActive. Browse/select when creating product. Product can belong to one or more categories.

Summary: Shop admin can create edit and manage products per store
Description: As shop admin I want to add and manage products for each store (name SKU description images price tax inventory) so that customers can browse and buy. Acceptance: Product linked to one store. Fields: name SKU unique per store description images price tax inventory weight. Status: DRAFT ACTIVE OUT_OF_STOCK DISCONTINUED. Only ACTIVE visible. CRUD and list with filters. Low stock threshold.

Summary: Shop admin can bulk import products via CSV/Excel
Description: As shop admin I want to upload CSV/Excel to create/update many products so that I can onboard catalog quickly. Acceptance: Validate headers and required fields. Create and update by SKU+store; error report with row and message. Optional async job and notification with error report. Limit file size and row count.

Summary: Shop admin gets alerts when product or store inventory is low
Description: As shop admin I want to set low-stock threshold per product or store and receive notifications when stock falls below so that I can restock in time. Acceptance: Configurable threshold. When quantity <= threshold flag product and trigger notification. Email or in-app per preferences. List filter by low stock.

Summary: Single screen listing all orders across stores with filters
Description: As shop admin I want to see all orders from all my stores on one screen with filters (store date range status payment status) so that I can manage fulfillment in one place. Acceptance: One list/API for all stores. Columns: order ID date store customer items total order status payment status. Filters pagination sort. Expand for details. Later: user access and data filtering.

Summary: Shop admin can update order status through fulfillment lifecycle
Description: As shop admin I want to update order status (confirmed to processing to shipped to delivered) and optionally add tracking so that customers and platform can track fulfillment. Acceptance: Statuses PLACED CONFIRMED PROCESSING SHIPPED DELIVERED CANCELLED RETURNED. Valid transitions. Set status; when SHIPPED add carrier and tracking. Read via API/notifications. Optional webhook on status change.

Summary: Shop admin can export filtered orders for reporting
Description: As shop admin I want to export current order list (with filters) to CSV or Excel so that I can use for accounting or reports. Acceptance: Export uses same filters. Format CSV or Excel; columns align with list. Limit size or async job with download link.

Summary: Shop admin can manage shipping: carriers tracking and optional labels
Description: As shop admin I want to select carrier add tracking when I ship and optionally generate labels so that orders are fulfilled and customers can track. Acceptance: Master carriers or add per store. When SHIPPED select carrier and tracking (and URL). Optional carrier API for labels. Optional expected delivery date.

Summary: Shop admin can process full or partial refunds with reason and approval
Description: As shop admin I want to initiate full or partial refunds with reason and optional approval workflow so that payments are reversed and disputes documented. Acceptance: Refund linked to order and optionally line items. Full or partial; amount currency reason. Status PENDING APPROVED PROCESSING COMPLETED FAILED. Order reflects refunded. Audit who when amount reason.

Summary: Customers can request returns; shop admin can approve receive and complete returns
Description: As shop admin I want to see return requests approve or reject mark return received and process refund/replacement so that returns are handled in a clear workflow. Acceptance: Return linked to order/line items reason photos status REQUESTED. List with filters. Approve with instructions or Reject. Mark return received; process refund/replacement; COMPLETED. Status flow REQUESTED to APPROVED/REJECTED to RETURN_RECEIVED to REFUNDED/REPLACED to COMPLETED.

Summary: Shop admin can add bank/payout account and set payout schedule
Description: As shop admin I want to add bank account and choose payout schedule (e.g. weekly) so that I can receive settlements. Acceptance: Add bank: holder name bank name account number IFSC/code optional proof. Payout schedule weekly bi-weekly cutoff and payout day. View and update; one primary per shop. Data masked and stored securely.

Summary: Shop admin can view payout statements and history
Description: As shop admin I want to view payout history and statements (amount date deductions) so that I can reconcile earnings. Acceptance: List payouts: date period gross deductions net status. Statement view or download PDF/CSV. Filters date range status.

Summary: Shop admin can configure tax registration and rates per store
Description: As shop admin I want to set GST/VAT registration and tax rates per store so that orders and payouts are tax-compliant. Acceptance: Per store: tax registration number tax-inclusive or exclusive. Optional default rate per product. Tax in order breakdown and payout statements. Stretch: tax report export.

Summary: Shop admin sees basic sales and order analytics on a dashboard
Description: As shop admin I want to see a simple dashboard with sales summary order trends and top products so that I understand performance. Acceptance: Widgets: total sales order count AOV. Chart orders/revenue over time. Top products by quantity/revenue. Filter by store or all. Data scoped to admin stores only.

Summary: Shop admin can manage notification preferences (email in-app)
Description: As shop admin I want to choose which notifications I receive (new order low stock return refund payout) and channel (email in-app) so that I am not overwhelmed. Acceptance: Toggles per event type. Channel email on/off in-app on/off. Saved per admin. Notifications respect preferences.

Summary: Platform can suspend a store; admin can view reason and request reinstatement
Description: As platform I want to suspend a store or shop so that they cannot sell until resolved. As shop admin I want to see reason and submit reinstatement request. Acceptance: Super-admin suspend with reason and date. Suspended: products hidden; admin limited. Admin sees banner and Request reinstatement. Platform can reinstate. Optional appeal workflow.

Summary: Implement registration API and validation for shop admin
Description: Implement registration form/API: accept business name type address phone tax ID and user name email password. Enforce unique email and password policy. Create shop record with PENDING_APPROVAL. Return clear validation errors.

Summary: Create Shop/SellerProfile entity and link to User
Description: Add Shop or SellerProfile entity with business info and status (PENDING_APPROVAL APPROVED REJECTED SUSPENDED). Link to User 1:1. Block seller dashboard access until APPROVED.

Summary: Implement document upload API and storage
Description: Allow upload of ID proof business registration address proof. Enforce file type and size (e.g. PDF JPG max 5MB). Store securely and link to shop profile. Return list of uploaded documents.

Summary: Platform UI to view and verify/reject documents
Description: Super-admin can view uploaded documents and mark as verified or rejected with reason. Admin can re-upload if rejected.

Summary: List pending shop admins with filters
Description: API and UI to list shop admins with status PENDING_APPROVAL. Filters: date business name. Super-admin can open profile and view business details and documents.

Summary: Approve/Reject actions and notifications
Description: Implement Approve and Reject with optional reason. On Approve set status APPROVED and send welcome email. On Reject set REJECTED notify admin with reason. Support reapply if needed.

Summary: Store CRUD and list for approved admin
Description: Only APPROVED shop can create stores. Create: name address phone logo business hours timezone currency. List edit deactivate. Unique store identifier (code/slug). Default shipping origin.

Summary: Enforce approval check and store authorization
Description: Middleware or guard: ensure user has APPROVED shop profile before store create/list. Scope all store APIs to shop admin's stores.

Summary: Category model and platform/store-level categories
Description: Categories at platform or store level. Fields: name parent (tree) image isActive. APIs to list and manage. Shop admin can browse when creating product.

Summary: Product category assignment in product form
Description: When creating/editing product allow selecting one or more categories. Persist and filter products by category.

Summary: Product CRUD and list APIs at store level
Description: Product linked to one store. Full CRUD. Fields: name SKU description images price tax inventory weight. Status DRAFT ACTIVE OUT_OF_STOCK DISCONTINUED. List with filters: store status category search. Only ACTIVE visible to customers.

Summary: Product status and low-stock threshold
Description: Implement status transitions and low-stock threshold (per product or store default). When quantity <= threshold flag and optionally auto-set OUT_OF_STOCK.

Summary: Bulk import endpoint and validation
Description: Accept CSV/Excel upload. Validate headers and required fields (name SKU price store). Support create and update by SKU+store. Return or store error report (row number message).

Summary: Async import job and error report for large files
Description: For large files run async job; notify admin when done; provide download link for error report. Enforce max file size and row count (e.g. 10k).

Summary: Low-stock threshold config and flagging
Description: Configurable threshold per product or default per store. When quantity <= threshold set low-stock flag and show in list. Filter products by low stock.

Summary: Low-stock notification trigger
Description: When stock falls below threshold trigger notification (email or in-app). Respect notification preferences (when implemented).

Summary: Unified orders list API for all stores
Description: Single API returning orders for all stores of logged-in shop admin. Columns: order ID date store customer items total order status payment status. Pagination and sort.

Summary: Order list filters and detail view
Description: Filters: store date range order status payment status. Expand or detail endpoint for line items shipping address payment info. Authorization: only admin's stores.

Summary: Order status enum and valid transitions
Description: Define statuses: PLACED CONFIRMED PROCESSING SHIPPED DELIVERED CANCELLED RETURNED. Enforce valid transitions. API to update status.

Summary: Carrier and tracking when marking SHIPPED
Description: When marking order SHIPPED require or allow carrier and tracking number (and URL). Expose status and tracking to customer and platform. Optional webhook on change.

Summary: Export orders API with same filters
Description: Export endpoint using same filters as order list. Format CSV or Excel. Columns aligned with list. Limit size (e.g. 50k) or async job with download link.

Summary: Carrier list and tracking on shipment
Description: Master list of carriers or per-store preferred. When SHIPPED store carrier tracking number and optional URL. Optional expected delivery date. Optional label generation or upload.

Summary: Refund entity and APIs
Description: Refund linked to order and optionally line items. Full or partial; amount currency reason. Status: PENDING APPROVED PROCESSING COMPLETED FAILED. Update order/payment status. Audit log.

Summary: Return request entity and list with filters
Description: Return linked to order/line items; reason photos status REQUESTED. List with filters by store order status. Approve with instructions or Reject with reason.

Summary: Return workflow: receive inspect refund/replace
Description: After approval admin marks return received. Then process refund (link to refund) or replacement. Status flow to COMPLETED. Notify customer.

Summary: Bank/payout account and schedule
Description: Add bank account (holder name bank IFSC account number optional proof). Payout schedule: weekly/bi-weekly cutoff and payout day. One primary per shop. Mask and store securely.

Summary: Payout list and statement download
Description: List payouts: date period gross deductions net status. Statement view or PDF/CSV download. Filters: date range status.

Summary: Tax registration and rates per store
Description: Per store: tax registration number (e.g. GSTIN); tax-inclusive or exclusive. Optional default tax rate per product. Show tax in order breakdown and payout statements.

Summary: Dashboard widgets and charts
Description: Widgets: total sales (today/week/month) order count AOV. Chart: orders or revenue over time. Top products by quantity/revenue. Filter by store or all. Scope to admin stores.

Summary: Notification preference toggles and storage
Description: Per-event toggles (new order low stock return refund payout). Channel: email on/off in-app on/off. Save per shop admin. Use when sending notifications.

Summary: Suspend store/shop and reinstatement flow
Description: Super-admin can suspend store or shop with reason and date. Suspended: products hidden; admin view-only or limited. Admin sees banner and Request reinstatement. Platform can reinstate. Optional appeal with comments/docs.
